comparison.objective: Remove a spring peg from a basket and clip a photo corner to a wire.
comparison.physical_skill: Squeeze-and-carry a sprung clip and align its jaws around wire and paper.
comparison.success_condition: A released second peg holds the photo corner for two seconds without dislodging it.
comparison.reason: Spring-clip placement is mechanically different from concentric driver/wrench counterholding and retained stop adjustment.
